sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 original and nearest4 actually viewed with unchanged mascot reference. Dark navy broad-brim fedora with wide black ribbon, sparse short grey/dark temple hair beneath hat, dark hairy brows, round dark/gold-rim clear reflective spectacles and a thin grey-dark moustache above one restrained closed/near-closed mouth; no distinct full beard. Slight screen-left three-quarter head/gaze. Dark blue-grey notched suit over white pointed collar and burgundy tie, bust cropped lower/sides; whole hat within canvas. Soft upper-left light and complete dark grey painted gradient backdrop, no card, frame, note or handwriting. Measured alpha243..255 near-opacity does not make this an exterior cutout; preserve complete backing and solid clothing. Fine spectacle reflections, moustache strands and weave are specific unreadable source limits under visible-source-differences-v1, no exact microdetail invented.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 original and nearest4 actually viewed with mascot reference. Strongly receding/bald central crown with short grey/black hair around upper rim and temples, grey-dark hairy brows, thick moustache connected to a short rounded grey/black beard around mouth/chin; no glasses or hat. Single calm closed mouth below moustache, near-frontal/slight screen-left three-quarter head/gaze. Dark olive standing-collar uniform, green collar tabs edged gold with pale round mark groups, central gold button, diagonal dark leather shoulder strap down screen-left with brass buckle/ring low on chest, partially cropped green/yellow ribbon group at lower screen-right. Bust crop, soft upper-left lighting and complete pale grey painted background; no note/card/frame. Alpha255 throughout. Tiny collar-mark relief, ribbon weave and individual hair strands unresolved at source resolution; retain visible groups without inventing precise emblems under visible-source-differences-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 source and nearest4 actually viewed with mascot reference. Reddish-brown swept rolled hair with lower side curls, clear dark hairy brows, large thin gold-rim round/aviator spectacles with clear reflective lenses. Visible small vertical/diagonal forehead scar above screen-left brow and red-brown cheek scar group below that spectacle; keep these actual visible mark groups, not invented decoration. Calm single closed/near-closed mouth, near-frontal/slight screen-right head turn. Blue-grey plaid collared blouse with peach/rust edging along collar and center placket, two brown decorative buttons; shoulders/bust cropped lower/sides. Soft upper-left illumination and complete dark-grey painted gradient background, no photo card/frame/note. Source alpha252..255 measured near-opacity is not exterior cutout. Fine scar branches, button motif, spectacle reflection and individual hair strands cannot be exactly resolved; record limits under visible-source-differences-v1 while preserving the visible scars/hair/eyewear.
